name: mc_sightline
title: Line of sight
description:
Tests lines of sight from an eye: whether given blocks are visible and, if not, what blocks the view. Rays use real block shapes (slabs, snow, fences and panes block only where they have shape; glass, pane gaps, bars and water do not block; leaves do). Read-only.

WHEN TO USE: "can a player see X from here?" (a landmark from spawn, a sign from a path) or what is in the way. targets: up to 256 blocks, each visible/blocked/unknown with the first blocking block and distances. cone: a coarse grid of first hits over a field of view. Add one mc_render first-person view only when the user wants to see it.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for walking or reachability (mc_walk); entities, fog, lighting and render distance are not traced; for exact blocks use mc_inspect.

PARAMETERS: one of eye or player, and one of targets or cone. A target counts as visible when a line to its centre or to the centre of a face turned toward the eye is clear; its own cell never blocks. Targets must be within 256 blocks. cone yaw/pitch are F3 degrees (yaw 0 south, 90 west, 180 north, -90 east; pitch -90 up, 90 down); fov 10-110, rays 4-48 per side, distance 8-256.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only. Chunks are read a few per tick; unloaded ones load in the background without generation (up to config limits.max-view-chunk-loads) and are not kept loaded. A line through a never-generated chunk, or one over that cap, answers unknown with the cell where it stopped. Cone output: one character per ray, rows top to bottom; 0-9 is the hit distance in tenths of the cone distance, '.' nothing hit, '?' unknown; plus the most common blocking blocks.

eye.description: Eye position [x, y, z], decimals allowed (a standing player's eye is feet + 1.62). Give eye or player.

player.description: An online player: uses their eye and look direction in their own world.

world.description: World for eye; default: the configured default world. Not with player.

targets.description: Block positions [x, y, z], at most 256.

cone.description: Coarse visibility grid instead of targets.

yaw.description: Default: the player's yaw (required with eye).

pitch.description: Default: the player's pitch (required with eye).

fov.description: Square field of view in degrees, default 70.

ignore.description: Blocks that do not block sight: ids (namespace optional, * wildcard) with optional [prop=value] or [prop<=n] conditions, e.g. "*_leaves", "snow[layers<=3]".
